text:
Anika Bose: quick thread about marketplace private-offer shape when there's a hardware trade-in + SI overlay. main trade-offs: simple flat discount vs commit-bands + true-up at renewal. thoughts? :thinking:

Diego Ramos: prefer commit-bands + soft true-up. flat discounts are fast but bleed margin long-term. bands encourage consumption and let us scale credits to actual usage.

Hannah Lee: agree. add an onboarding consumption floor (make-good) so PoCs don't trip early. propose: 3mo onboarding floor = 10% of annual commit. if floor not hit, partner gets a 1x extension window to meet it before adjustment.

Samir Patel: for hardware trade-ins, convert partner rebate into equipment allowance applied as a credit to their next invoice. important: credit is non-transferable except in defined SI bundle transfers. legal will want explicit transferability language.

Diego Ramos: also recommend an "early-adopter uplift" for customers who sign within 60 days of announcement: +5% rebate for yr1 only. helps SI momentum.

Anika Bose: can we codify renewal true-up flow? simple steps: 1) measure actual consumption vs committed bands; 2) apply shortfall true-up (monetary) or grant extra rebate if exceeded; 3) allow partner to carry one-time surplus credit into next year. Samir — finance + legal OK?

Samir Patel: finance prefers monetary true-up on invoice, but flexible to allow credit carry-forward for up to 12 months. legal flagged change-of-control, and wants a clause that credits expire on company M&A unless buyer assumes obligations.

Hannah Lee: operational checklist: marketplace private-offer SKU must include metadata: commit band, onboarding floor, early-adopter flag, hw-credit flow, SI-overlay % (if any). Also add a 30-day notice to customers before any revert to standard pricing.

MarketplaceBot: created draft template mp/private-offer-commit-band-with-hw-credit in /mp-templates. Link: https://redwood.internal/mp-templates/private-offer-commit-band-hw-credit. Review and comment by EOD Thu.

Anika Bose: next steps: Diego -> draft commit-band tiers + uplift math (Tue EOD), Hannah -> onboarding floor and renewal language (Tue), Samir -> get finance/legal sign-off on invoice true-up vs credit carry (Wed). Scheduling 20m sync Fri 09:30. Thanks! :pray:
